title: Lunatic Frequencies
subtitle: Test your understanding of Lunatic Frequencies — negative lunar broadcasts from a hidden station, and the hologram that masks the craft.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The disturbances that arrive with the full moon are broadcasts, not a natural tide in the body. A station hidden behind a spherical projection sends them, and a hologram disguised as Venus keeps that station looking like the moon. The craft can phase to other worlds and run the same signal. Seeing the artificial origin is the start of recognizing that control and setting it aside.

questions.question: What do these named transmissions amount to?

options.label: A
options.text: Natural moonlight gathered from ordinary lunar tides and sent back toward the realm
options.rationale: The transmissions are harmful electromagnetic waves, not moonlight gathered from tides.

options.label: B
options.text: Harmful electromagnetic waves directed toward Earth on designated orbital cycles
options.rationale: Lunatic Frequencies are low-vibrational and harmful electromagnetic waves directed toward Earth during designated orbital cycles.

options.label: C
options.text: A command timetable that sets when each lunar stage begins and ends in orbit
options.rationale: A timetable is not the transmission. The waves themselves are harmful electromagnetic waves directed toward Earth.

options.label: D
options.text: Visual camouflage wrapped around the space station by the Venus hologram
options.rationale: Camouflage is the shell around the station. The transmissions are harmful electromagnetic waves directed toward Earth.

questions.hint: Look at the glossary line for what these transmissions are.

questions.question: When is this broadcast at its strongest?

options.label: A
options.text: The pause as the craft dematerialises
options.rationale: Dematerialising is how the craft phases. The peak broadcast is during a full moon.

options.label: B
options.text: The full moon stage of the cycle
options.rationale: Controlled lunar stages reach peak operational intensity during a full moon, when the station broadcasts its highest concentration of negative frequencies.

options.label: C
options.text: The phased crossing out of this realm
options.rationale: Phasing moves the craft between worlds. Peak output is during a full moon.

options.label: D
options.text: The first casting of the hologram shell
options.rationale: The shell hides the craft. The highest concentration of negative frequencies goes out at the full moon.

questions.hint: Look in the overview for when the station pushes hardest.

questions.question: Where does the word lunatic come from?

options.label: A
options.text: Optical camouflage of the holographic shell that hides the craft
options.rationale: The shell hides the station. The word comes from the operational influence of the lunar stage.

options.label: B
options.text: Operational influence of the lunar stage that induces mental disturbance
options.rationale: Lunatic originates from the operational influence of the lunar stage, denoting states of mental disturbance induced by lunar transmissions.

options.label: C
options.text: Harvest work of the command node that fills the station hold
options.rationale: Harvesting is a job of the craft. The word comes from the operational influence of the lunar stage.

options.label: D
options.text: Phasing travel across gateway-10 that shifts the craft away
options.rationale: Phasing moves the craft. The word comes from the operational influence of the lunar stage.

questions.hint: Look at the glossary line for where this word comes from.

questions.question: Where does this broadcast come from?

options.label: A
options.text: A harvesting hall fixed on the surface of this realm
options.rationale: The source is a covert station hidden behind a spherical projection, not a hall on the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: A covert station hidden behind a spherical projection
options.rationale: The broadcasting mechanism emanates from a covert negative ET space station hidden behind a spherical projection.

options.label: C
options.text: A luminescent sphere that is the craft solid hull
options.rationale: The glowing sphere is a projection over the craft, not the hull itself.

options.label: D
options.text: A gateway-10 opening standing in the night sky overhead
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the route the craft phases across. The broadcast comes from a station hidden behind a spherical projection.

questions.hint: Look at the end of the overview for the source of the broadcast.

questions.question: How does the underlying craft appear when it is disguised?

options.label: A
options.text: A standard celestial body drawn across the night sky
options.rationale: The craft is disguised in the night sky as a standard celestial body.

options.label: B
options.text: A ground station broadcasting from inside this realm
options.rationale: The craft is off-world and disguised in the night sky as a standard celestial body.

options.label: C
options.text: A visible command tower beside the holographic shell
options.rationale: The craft is not left visible beside the shell. It is disguised as a standard celestial body.

options.label: D
options.text: An uncovered craft parked ahead of the Venus hologram
options.rationale: The hologram covers the craft. What appears is a standard celestial body.

questions.hint: Look in the core section for how the craft is presented overhead.

questions.question: Which set of jobs belongs to the underlying craft?

options.label: A
options.text: An orbital cycle, a signal spike, and a lunar disturbance
options.rationale: Those describe the broadcast pattern. The craft is a frequency control centre, command node, and harvesting facility.

options.label: B
options.text: A luminescent sphere, a full moon mark, and an optical shield
options.rationale: The sphere and the shield are the mask. The craft is a frequency control centre, command node, and harvesting facility.

options.label: C
options.text: A frequency control centre, a command node, and a harvesting facility
options.rationale: The underlying craft operates as a multi-functional frequency control centre, command node, and harvesting facility.

options.label: D
options.text: A holographic shell, a lunar stage, and a spherical projection
options.rationale: Those are the mask and the cycle. The craft is a frequency control centre, command node, and harvesting facility.

questions.hint: Look in the core section for the jobs named for this craft.

questions.question: What on the craft governs the timing and intensity of every lunar stage?

options.label: A
options.text: The holographic shell cast around the station
options.rationale: The shell is camouflage. Timing is governed by the command and communications platform.

options.label: B
options.text: The command and communications platform
options.rationale: The central craft functions as a specialized command and communications platform that governs the timing and intensity of every lunar stage.

options.label: C
options.text: The harvesting facility inside the same craft
options.rationale: Harvesting is a separate job. The command and communications platform governs each lunar stage.

options.label: D
options.text: The luminescent sphere projected over the hull
options.rationale: The sphere is the mask. The command and communications platform governs the stages.

questions.hint: Look in the signal section for what governs the stages.

questions.question: What do these negative frequencies do to planetary populations?

options.label: A
options.text: They open gateway-10 and carry the craft across to other worlds
options.rationale: Crossing worlds is the craft phasing. The frequencies manipulate mental states and maintain energetic suppression.

options.label: B
options.text: They time each lunar stage from the command platform above the craft hull
options.rationale: Timing belongs to the command platform. The frequencies manipulate mental states and maintain energetic suppression.

options.label: C
options.text: They manipulate mental states and keep energetic suppression in place
options.rationale: These negative frequencies directly impact planetary populations, manipulating mental states and maintaining energetic suppression.

options.label: D
options.text: They paint the spherical shell that hides the station from view
options.rationale: The shell comes from the hologram. The frequencies manipulate mental states and maintain energetic suppression.

questions.hint: Look at what the spikes do to populations.

questions.question: What does the Venus hologram do?

options.label: A
options.text: It stores the harvest gathered by the command node
options.rationale: Harvesting is a job of the craft. The hologram projects the spherical illumination covering the physical craft.

options.label: B
options.text: It sets the timing and intensity of every lunar stage
options.rationale: Timing belongs to the command platform. The hologram projects the spherical illumination covering the physical craft.

options.label: C
options.text: It projects spherical illumination over the physical craft
options.rationale: The Venus hologram projects the spherical illumination covering the physical craft.

options.label: D
options.text: It phases the craft between this realm and the other worlds
options.rationale: Phasing is how the craft moves. The hologram projects the spherical illumination covering the physical craft.

questions.hint: Look at the glossary line for the generator disguised as a planet.

questions.question: What would show if the Venus hologram stopped working?

options.label: A
options.text: The physical craft would periodically show where the moon is drawn in the sky
options.rationale: Without the active operation of the Venus hologram, the physical craft would periodically show where the moon is drawn in the sky.

options.label: B
options.text: Gateway-10 would close and pin the craft inside this one realm
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the phasing route. Without the hologram, the craft would show where the moon is drawn.

options.label: C
options.text: The holographic shell would thicken and seal the station inside it
options.rationale: Stopping the hologram removes the shell. The physical craft would show where the moon is drawn.

options.label: D
options.text: The Venus mark would drop out of the evening sky above the realm
options.rationale: What shows is the physical craft where the moon is drawn, not Venus dropping out of the sky.

questions.hint: Look at what becomes visible if that generator stops.

questions.question: How does the craft move between this realm and other worlds?

options.label: A
options.text: It waits in the facility until the full moon
options.rationale: The full moon is a broadcast peak. Movement is to materialise and dematerialise in situ.

options.label: B
options.text: It materialises and dematerialises in situ
options.rationale: The craft can materialise and dematerialise in situ, phasing between this realm and other target worlds across gateway-10.

options.label: C
options.text: It stays masked in the projection and holds still
options.rationale: The projection hides it. The craft still materialises and dematerialises in situ.

options.label: D
options.text: It slides along the shell into the next realm
options.rationale: The shell is camouflage, not a road. The craft materialises and dematerialises in situ.

questions.hint: Look in the phasing section for how the craft changes place.

questions.question: What does frequency control mean here?

options.label: A
options.text: Phasing travel that carries the same broadcasts across other target worlds
options.rationale: Phasing moves the craft. Frequency control is the alteration of planetary vibrational environments.

options.label: B
options.text: Calculated spikes of signal output during each full moon stage
options.rationale: Spikes are one action of the station. Frequency control is the alteration of planetary vibrational environments.

options.label: C
options.text: Altering planetary vibrational environments through artificial stations
options.rationale: Frequency control is the systematic administration and alteration of planetary vibrational environments via artificial broadcasting stations.

options.label: D
options.text: Optical camouflage cast around the station by the Venus hologram
options.rationale: That is the holographic shell. Frequency control alters planetary vibrational environments through artificial stations.

questions.hint: Look at the glossary definition of this term.

questions.question: What is the holographic shell?

options.label: A
options.text: The command link that sets every lunar stage from orbit
options.rationale: That link is the command platform. The shell is visual optical camouflage cast around the space station.

options.label: B
options.text: The pathway the craft uses to phase across gateway-10
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the phasing route. The shell is visual optical camouflage cast around the space station.

options.label: C
options.text: Visual optical camouflage cast around the space station
options.rationale: The holographic shell is the visual optical camouflage cast around the space station to obscure its structural appearance.

options.label: D
options.text: The harvest store held inside the off-world facility
options.rationale: Harvesting is inside the craft. The shell is visual optical camouflage cast around the space station.

questions.hint: Look at the glossary line for the shell around the station.

questions.question: What does the Venus hologram do for the craft while it transmits?

options.label: A
options.text: It gathers the incoming harvest inside the station command node
options.rationale: Harvesting is a job of the craft. The hologram keeps it masked behind a continuous spherical illusion.

options.label: B
options.text: It keeps the broadcasting craft masked behind a continuous spherical illusion
options.rationale: The Venus hologram keeps the broadcasting craft masked behind a continuous spherical illusion while transmitting across the realm.

options.label: C
options.text: It raises the signal spikes that hit populations at the full moon
options.rationale: The spikes come from the station. The hologram keeps the craft masked behind a continuous spherical illusion.

options.label: D
options.text: It carries the craft across gateway-10 over toward another world
options.rationale: Crossing worlds is the craft phasing. The hologram keeps it masked behind a continuous spherical illusion.

questions.hint: Look in the broader section for what the generator does while the signal runs.

questions.question: What does the deployment of these frequencies rely on?

options.label: A
options.text: Natural celestial effects drawn from the lunar cycle onto human bodies
options.rationale: The shifts are not natural celestial effects. Deployment uses the off-world craft and its optical shielding.

options.label: B
options.text: Ground relays inside this realm that rebroadcast each lunar stage
options.rationale: The account does not place relays on the ground. Deployment uses the off-world craft and its optical shielding.

options.label: C
options.text: Mechanical parts in the off-world craft and its optical shielding
options.rationale: Deployment relies on precise mechanical and technological components integrated within the off-world craft and its optical shielding.

options.label: D
options.text: A fixed hull that stays in one patch of sky and does not phase
options.rationale: The craft is not fixed in one place. Deployment uses the off-world craft and its optical shielding.

questions.hint: Look at the opening of the mechanics section for what the deployment uses.

questions.question: What kind of periodic disturbance does this account expose?

options.label: A
options.text: Natural celestial effects tied to the lunar cycle
options.rationale: The disturbances are not natural celestial effects. They are synthetic and correspond with the full moon.

options.label: B
options.text: Ordinary biological changes tied to the lunar cycle
options.rationale: The account moves the cause off ordinary biology. The disturbances are synthetic.

options.label: C
options.text: Unplanned emotional swings tied to the lunar cycle
options.rationale: The swings are engineered. They are synthetic disturbances corresponding with the full moon.

options.label: D
options.text: Synthetic disturbances tied to the full moon
options.rationale: Understanding these frequencies exposes the synthetic nature of periodic emotional and psychological disturbances corresponding with the full moon.

questions.hint: Look in the strategic section for what kind of disturbance this is.

questions.question: What change of view does the word lunatic demand?

options.label: A
options.text: It moves the cause from biological phenomena to technological intervention
options.rationale: The term shifts the understanding of human behavioral shifts from natural biological phenomena to technological intervention.

options.label: B
options.text: It moves the cause from frequency control to a harvest schedule
options.rationale: Harvesting stays a job of the craft. The word shifts the cause to technological intervention.

options.label: C
options.text: It moves the cause from the craft broadcasts to ordinary moonlight
options.rationale: The shift runs the other way, from natural biological phenomena to technological intervention.

options.label: D
options.text: It moves the cause from the Venus hologram across into gateway-10 travel paths
options.rationale: The hologram and the phasing are parts of the system. The word shifts the cause to technological intervention.

questions.hint: Look at how the strategic section recasts the old biological story.

questions.question: What does identifying the artificial origin of these transmissions provide?

options.label: A
options.text: A seal that closes gateway-10 against the incoming phasing craft
options.rationale: Recognition does not close gateway-10. It is a foundational key to recognizing and neutralizing the control.

options.label: B
options.text: A reversal of the station orbit around this realm from above it
options.rationale: Recognition does not reverse an orbit. It is a foundational key to recognizing and neutralizing external frequency control.

options.label: C
options.text: A foundational key to recognizing and neutralizing external frequency control
options.rationale: Identifying the artificial origin provides a foundational key to recognizing and neutralizing external frequency control mechanisms.

options.label: D
options.text: A switch that shuts the Venus hologram off on every target world
options.rationale: Recognition does not switch the hologram off. It is a foundational key to recognizing and neutralizing external frequency control.

questions.hint: Look at the last line of the strategic section.

questions.question: How does the station change what it sends during its strongest phases?

options.label: A
options.text: Steady harvest pulses stored inside the command node
options.rationale: Harvesting is a separate job. The output change is calculated spikes in signal output.

options.label: B
options.text: Random leaks of optical light through the holographic shell
options.rationale: The shell is a mask, not a leak. The station executes calculated spikes in signal output.

options.label: C
options.text: Calculated spikes in signal output during peak phases
options.rationale: During peak operational phases, particularly the full moon, the station executes calculated spikes in signal output.

options.label: D
options.text: Slow phasing steps that carry the craft out of this realm
options.rationale: Phasing moves the craft. The output change is calculated spikes in signal output.

questions.hint: Look in the signal section for how the output changes at the high point.

questions.question: What are the severe frequencies designed to do to people?

options.label: A
options.text: They repair human perception and restore emotional stability
options.rationale: The frequencies are harmful. They interfere with human perception and emotional stability.

options.label: B
options.text: They hide human perception behind the holographic shell
options.rationale: The shell hides the craft. The frequencies interfere with human perception and emotional stability.

options.label: C
options.text: They transfer human perception into the harvesting facility
options.rationale: The facility is part of the craft. The frequencies interfere with human perception and emotional stability.

options.label: D
options.text: They interfere with human perception and emotional stability
options.rationale: During a full moon the station pushes severe negative frequencies designed to interfere with human perception and emotional stability.

questions.hint: Look in the core section for what the severe output is designed to reach.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a real role in this layout?

options.label: A
options.text: The holographic shell, used as the drive that phases the craft
options.rationale: The holographic shell is visual optical camouflage. The craft materialises and dematerialises in situ when it phases.

options.label: B
options.text: A command node housed inside the same off-world craft
options.rationale: That role is real. The craft operates as a command node.

options.label: C
options.text: A harvesting facility carried aboard that same craft
options.rationale: That role is real. The craft operates as a harvesting facility.

options.label: D
options.text: A frequency control centre assigned across all the lunar stages
options.rationale: That role is real. The craft operates as a frequency control centre.

questions.hint: Match each line to the jobs named for the craft in the core section.

questions.question: True or False: The broadcast emanates from a covert negative ET space station.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: This broadcasting mechanism emanates from a covert negative ET space station hidden behind a spherical projection.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The overview says the mechanism emanates from a covert negative ET space station.

questions.hint: Look at the end of the overview for what sends the broadcast.

questions.question: True or False: Behavioral shifts linked to lunar cycles are natural celestial effects.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Those shifts are artificially engineered phenomena rather than natural celestial effects.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Behavioral shifts historically associated with lunar cycles are artificially engineered phenomena rather than natural celestial effects.

questions.hint: Look in the core section for whether those shifts are natural.

questions.question: True or False: Turning the Venus hologram off makes Planet Venus vanish from the evening sky.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Stopping the hologram does not erase Venus. The physical craft would periodically show where the moon is drawn in the sky.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Without the Venus hologram, the physical craft would periodically show where the moon is drawn in the sky.

questions.hint: Look at what the masking section says would show if that generator stopped.

questions.question: True or False: This frequency control can be deployed across multiple worlds connected through gateway-10.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Interdimensional mobility lets the frequency control mechanism be deployed across multiple worlds connected through gateway-10.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The broader section says the mechanism is deployed across multiple worlds connected through gateway-10.

questions.hint: Look in the broader section for where else the vessel can run the signal.
